sentences.text: Shri Narottam Sharma- Advocate for the respondent No.2

This application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashment of FIR in Crime No.402/2019 registered at Police Station Bahodapur, District Gwalior for offence under Sections 420, 406 and 120-B of IPC as well as criminal proceedings in RCT No.3699/2019 pending before the Court of JMFC, Gwalior.
2.
It appears that the real complainant is Shriram Transport Finance Company Limited.
An application under Section 320(2) of Cr.P.C. was filed before Trial Court alleging that parties have compromised the matter.

However, as offence under Section 120-B of IPC was not compoundable,
therefore, the said application was not accepted.
Even before the Trial Court, no authority letter issued by Shriram Transport Finance Company Limited to enter into compromise was filed.

Even in this case, nothing has been placed on record to show that compromise has been accepted by Shriram Transport NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:22117 2 MCRC-31228-2024 Finance Company Limited or not ?
3.

sentences.text: Accordingly, counsel for applicants seek permission of this Court to withdraw this application with liberty to file afresh alongwith complete order-sheets of Trial Court to show the stage of trial as well as authority letter issued by headquarters of Shriram Transport Finance Company Limited thereby acknowledging that they have entered into compromise with the applicants.
5. With aforesaid liberty, the application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE PjS/-
